build_minicpm3_causal_lm: build a MiniCPM3ForCausalLM model instance from a HuggingFace PretrainedConfig for inference
load_minicpm3_weights: load HuggingFace weights into a MiniCPM3ForCausalLM model with support for gated MLP sharding and MoE expert mapping
run_minicpm3_forward: run a forward pass on MiniCPM3ForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and a ForwardBatch for token generation
build_minicpm3_attention_mla: build a MiniCPM3AttentionMLA layer with MLA-style multi-head latent attention and optional float8 bmm optimization
build_minicpm3_decoder_layer: build a MiniCPM3DecoderLayer with self-attention, MLP, and residual connections scaled by config.scale_depth
